subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should iOS permanently remove the standalone Talk destination and make Chat the sole surface for dictation, voice notes, and realtime voice, with existing `talk` and `voice` launch aliases opening Chat?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and directly demonstrated, but the choice changes a shipped navigation model and user workflow; code review cannot decide whether that product and upgrade tradeoff is desired.

options.title: Approve unified Chat
options.body: Accept Chat as the permanent single conversational surface and merge after the named iOS owner confirms the redirect and upgrade contract.

options.title: Keep Talk as a destination
options.body: Retain a separate Talk entry point and narrow the PR to shared ownership or presentation fixes that do not replace the existing navigation model.

recommendation.title: Approve unified Chat
recommendation.body: Accept Chat as the permanent single conversational surface and merge after the named iOS owner confirms the redirect and upgrade contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They were explicitly routed into the prior review for this navigation and upgrade decision.
